2609.21996.title: A Lie Detector Test for Language Models: Reading Knowledge a Model Won't Reveal
2609.21996.paper_summary: Large language models can hold knowledge they do not report. A model may sandbag on a capability evaluation, or answer against what it internally knows, and its outputs alone cannot tell whether it is hiding an answer or simply does not have one. We borrow the Concealed Information Test, a forensic method that identifies guilty knowledge by presenting a suspect with the true detail among plausible decoys and measuring a stronger response to the item they recognize. Our method, Probe of Internal Recognition (PIR), does the same inside a model. It presents a question with its candidate answers and reads, from the model's internal states, which candidate the model recognizes as correct. PIR is reference-free, needing no honest reference model and no labeled truth corpus. Across eight models from five families (Gemma, Qwen, Llama, Mistral, and Phi), PIR recovers the recognized answer at 0.70 to 0.87 balanced accuracy, well above the 0.28 to 0.40 unknown-item baseline and the 0.25 chance rate. It stays readable across every form of concealment we test, from prompted deception and trained sandbagging to external password-locked and circuit-broken checkpoints, with recognition between 0.85 and 0.93. When the model hides a known answer, recognition stays high. When unlearning removes the knowledge, recognition drops to the level of a question the model never knew. PIR therefore separates a model that will not answer from one that cannot, which supports sandbagging audits and unlearning verification. The signal is causal, adds information beyond black-box behavioral cues, and extends from multiple-choice questions to free-form generation.
2609.21996.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以持有它們不報告的知識。模型可能在能力評估上故意低估表現，或根據其內部所知回答，而僅僅根據其輸出無法判斷它是隱藏答案還是根本沒有答案。我們借用隱藏資訊測試，這是一種法醫方法，通過向嫌疑人呈現真實細節與可信的誘餌，並測量他們對認識到的項目的更強反應來識別有罪知識。我們的方法，內部識別探測（PIR），在模型內部做同樣的事情。它呈現一個問題及其候選答案，並從模型的內部狀態中讀取模型識別為正確的候選答案。PIR 是無參考的，無需誠實的參考模型和標記的真實語料庫。在五個家族的八個模型（Gemma、Qwen、Llama、Mistral 和 Phi）中，PIR 在 0.70 到 0.87 的平衡準確率下恢復了識別的答案，遠高於 0.28 到 0.40 的未知項基線和 0.25 的機會率。它在我們測試的每種隱藏形式中保持可讀性，從提示的欺騙和訓練的低估到外部密碼鎖定和電路斷開的檢查點，識別率介於 0.85 和 0.93 之間。當模型隱藏已知答案時，識別率保持高位。當去學習移除知識時，識別率下降到模型從未知道的問題水平。因此，PIR 將不會回答的模型與不能回答的模型區分開來，這支持低估審計和去學習驗證。信號是因果的，提供超越黑箱行為線索的信息，並從多選題擴展到自由形式生成。
